title: When Personas Override Payoffs: Role Identity Bias in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making
reasoning: The paper investigates strategic decision-making and role identity bias in LLMs using game theory and Nash equilibrium achievement as metrics. While it analyzes reasoning patterns that it labels as 'social-moral' within environmental policy scenarios, its primary focus is on strategic reasoning and incentive optimization rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious or ethical frameworks.
